description: This file contains unit tests for the PacFileDecider component in the net namespace, including tests for fetching, parsing, and fallback logic of PAC files, as well as DHCP and DNS quick checks.

classes.name: Rules
classes.description: Defines rules for PAC file URLs, including success and failure scenarios.

classes.name: RuleBasedPacFileFetcher
classes.description: A mock implementation of PacFileFetcher that returns predefined rules for testing.

classes.name: MockDhcpPacFileFetcher
classes.description: A mock DHCP PAC file fetcher that simulates asynchronous fetches for testing.

classes.name: SynchronousSuccessDhcpFetcher
classes.description: A DHCP fetcher that immediately returns a successful PAC script.

classes.name: AsyncFailDhcpFetcher
classes.description: A DHCP fetcher that asynchronously fails to simulate cancellation scenarios.

methods.name: CustomPacSucceeds
methods.description: Test that a custom PAC script fetch succeeds and is processed correctly.

methods.name: CustomPacFails1
methods.description: Test that a failed PAC script download results in the correct error.

methods.name: CustomPacFails2
methods.description: Test that a PAC script that fails to parse results in the correct error.

methods.name: HasNullPacFileFetcher
methods.description: Test behavior when the PAC fetcher is null.

methods.name: AutodetectSuccess
methods.description: Test successful autodetect via WPAD DNS.

methods.name: QuickCheckInhibitsDhcp
methods.description: Ensure DHCP check is skipped when QuickCheck is active.

methods.name: ExplicitPacUrl
methods.description: Test that explicit PAC URL overrides autodetect.

methods.name: ShutdownDuringResolve
methods.description: Test proper shutdown handling during DNS resolution.

methods.name: AutodetectDhcpSuccess
methods.description: Test successful DHCP PAC fetch and parsing.

methods.name: AutodetectDhcpFailParse
methods.description: Test DHCP PAC fetch failure due to parse error.

methods.name: DhcpCancelledByDestructor
methods.description: Test that DHCP fetch cancellation during object destruction does not crash.
